caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

Did You Know how self-driving cars actually 'see' the road and everything around them, even in the dark? 🤯

💡 Self-driving cars use a super-sense combo of LiDAR, radar, and ultrasonic sensors to build a detailed 3D map, seeing the world far better than humans.
